formatted_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  total_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN total_amount >= 2000
    THEN 'high'
    WHEN total_amount >= 1000
    THEN 'medium'
    ELSE 'low'
  END AS amount_band
FROM fact_orders
WHERE
  status = 'completed'
  AND order_date >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND order_date < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE)
ORDER BY
  total_amount DESC,
  order_id ASC
